abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Information and communication technology (ICT) goods are central to digital transformation, technological upgrading and participation in global production networks. Yet relatively little is known about whether immigrant networks shape international trade in these knowledge‐intensive goods. Using bilateral panel data for 172 countries over the 2000–2021 period, we estimate gravity‐based specifications, Tobit models and linear fixed‐effects models for ICT goods trade. The results show a positive and statistically significant relationship between immigrant networks and ICT goods trade, especially exports. The export relationship remains positive after controlling for productive capacity, while the import relationship weakens. Interaction models further show that immigrant networks are more strongly related to ICT goods trade when immigrants' home countries have greater ICT export capacity. Marginal‐effect estimates indicate that the relationship operates through both the extensive and intensive margins of trade. The findings suggest that immigrant networks are especially relevant for ICT goods trade when cross‐border social and commercial ties connect destination markets to technologically capable home countries.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 信息与通信技术（ICT）产品是数字化转型、技术升级及参与全球生产网络的核心要素。然而，关于移民网络是否影响这类知识密集型产品的国际贸易，学界认知仍相对有限。本研究基于2000—2021年间172个国家的双边面板数据，采用引力模型设定、Tobit模型及线性固定效应模型对ICT产品贸易进行估计。结果显示，移民网络与ICT产品贸易（尤其是出口）之间存在显著正向统计关系。在控制生产能力后，出口关系仍保持正向，而进口关系则有所减弱。交互模型进一步表明，当移民母国具备更强的ICT出口能力时，移民网络与ICT产品贸易的关联性更为显著。边际效应估计显示，该关系通过贸易的扩展边际与集约边际共同发挥作用。研究结论表明，当跨境社会与商业联系将目的地市场与技术能力较强的母国相连接时，移民网络对ICT产品贸易具有特殊重要性。
title:
Immigrant Networks, Productive Capacity and Trade in
                    ICT
                    Goods
title_zh: 移民网络、生产能力与ICT产品贸易

abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper uses linked Census records from 1871 to 1901 to compute intergenerational mobility for Canadian regions and census divisions. The results reveal sharp differences in mobility over space: Ontario featured high relative and absolute mobility, Quebec low relative and absolute mobility and the Maritimes low absolute mobility. Local differences in human capital endowments and labour market inequality are correlated with division mobility patterns but do not account for regional differences, where migration and structural change toward industry and services appear important. Comparing spatial patterns of Canadian mobility in the 19th century to today shows substantial changes for Quebec districts.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 本文利用1871年至1901年的关联人口普查记录，计算了加拿大各地区及普查分区的代际流动性。结果显示，不同地区的流动性存在显著差异：安大略省具有较高的相对流动性和绝对流动性，魁北克省则表现出较低的相对流动性和绝对流动性，而滨海省份的绝对流动性较低。地方人力资本禀赋和劳动力市场不平等与分区流动性模式相关，但无法解释区域差异，其中向工业和服务业的迁移及结构转型似乎更为重要。将19世纪加拿大流动性的空间格局与当今对比，发现魁北克地区发生了显著变化。
title: The geography of economic mobility in 19th‐century Canada
title_zh: 19世纪加拿大经济流动性的地理分布

title: Endowments-swapping-proof object reallocation with transfers
title_zh: 带转移支付的禀赋互换防操纵物品再配置

abstract: Abstract We analyze competition in service markets with unit demand prone to adverse selection, such as secured lending and car insurance markets. Incumbent firms learn their customers’ types over time and can price discriminate accordingly. We prove existence of a unique set of mixed strategy equilibria where firms randomize prices over a bounded continuous support. Incumbents earn positive rents. Increased competition through firm entry does not benefit customers if firms know portfolio compositions of competitors. If firms only possess information regarding the aggregate industry client composition, horizontal mergers may reduce industry rents, a finding with implications for competition policy in information-intensive industries.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们分析了存在逆向选择风险的单元需求服务市场中的竞争，例如担保贷款和汽车保险市场。在位企业会随时间推移了解客户类型，并据此实施价格歧视。我们证明存在一组唯一的混合策略均衡，其中企业在有界连续支撑集上随机定价。在位企业可获得正租金。若企业了解竞争对手的投资组合构成，则通过企业进入加剧竞争并不会使客户受益。若企业仅掌握行业整体客户构成的汇总信息，横向并购可能降低行业租金，这一发现对信息密集型行业的竞争政策具有启示意义。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Competition on service markets with unit demand and learning
title_zh: 单位需求与学习效应下的服务市场竞争

abstract: Abstract We propose a novel measure of fiscal policy divergence based on public budget data. First, we quantify policy similarity across municipalities based on the cosine similarity of their budget allocations, showing strong correlations with geographic proximity and differences in socio-demographic characteristics. Next, we predict budget similarity out-of-sample using a flexible machine-learning model trained on pairwise differences in local characteristics, defining fiscal divergence as the municipality-year average absolute prediction error. In an empirical application to 8000 Italian municipalities (2000–2015), we show that electoral-cycle patterns are concentrated on the expenditure side of the budget: expenditure divergence is lower in pre-electoral years than in election years, whereas revenue divergence follows a different and less stable pattern.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文基于公共预算数据提出了一种衡量财政政策差异的新方法。首先，我们利用预算分配的余弦相似度量化各市镇间的政策相似性，发现其与地理邻近性及社会人口特征差异存在强相关性。其次，我们采用灵活的机器学习模型，基于地方特征的两两差异对预算相似性进行样本外预测，并将财政差异定义为市镇-年份层面平均绝对预测误差。在对意大利8000个市镇（2000-2015年）的实证分析中，我们发现选举周期模式集中于预算支出端：选举前年份的支出差异低于选举年份，而收入差异则呈现不同且较不稳定的模式。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Fiscal policy divergence

abstract: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the healthstatus gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.
abstract_zh: 本文利用14至19世纪中国的家谱数据，研究健康与社会地位之间的关系。数据覆盖了广泛的社会阶层，将丈夫、妻子和儿子联系起来，使我们能够考察地位是否不仅与成年男性的生存状况相关，还涉及家庭内部及代际之间的影响。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的典型寿命为52岁，但个体差异显著。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高22%，寿命优势达七年。高地位还与妻子和子女的显著生存优势相关：高地位男性妻子的寿命比平民妻子长超过10年，而高地位男性之子在10岁前死亡的概率不到低地位男性之子的一半。直至17世纪，寿命优势主要局限于顶级地位群体，而18世纪期间，所有地位层级之间均出现了健康-地位梯度。这些发现为较少被研究的背景下的健康-地位不平等提供了新证据，并表明从家庭和代际视角分析健康-地位不平等具有重要价值。
authors: Wolfgang Keller; Carol Shiue; Karen Eggleston

title: New Evidence on the Health-Status Gradient from Imperial China
